newsitem.title: USA: FFVA Financial gets OK to buy back shares.
newsitem.headline: FFVA Financial gets OK to buy back shares.

text.p: FFVA Financial Corp said on Tuesday that it has received regulatory approval to repurchase up to 502,255 shares of common stock.

The company had previously been authorized by its board of directors to repurchase up to 10 percent of its 5,022,552 outstanding shares of common stock, but had been awaiting approval to initiate the buyback.
The buy back is to be made on the open market. Repurchased shares are to be cancelled and retired, it said. FFVA Financial is the holding company for First Federal Savings Bank of Lynchburg, Va.
